lines: Making a death(?) cry, an octopus was cut right in half by Octo-Slayer-san's sword.
「A-Awesome! You really wiped them out, almost single-handed!」
He hadn't been visible because it had been too packed with octopuses, but Fuuma lay collapsed at the back of the chamber.
「N...... No, I... got swept away on purpose, to try and find their nest......」
「That's obviously a lie, isn't it?! Don't try too hard to act like a strategist!」
「More importantly, is Fuuma the only one here? Where are the other Taimanin that got kidnapped?!」
「Come to think of it...... When I woke up, it was nothing but octopus as far as the eye could see.」
One of them, which appeared to have been hiding, took advantage of the moment to flee deeper inside.
「After it! If even a single one remains, they'll multiply infinitely!」
「Those guys cut off their own legs to make more of them.」
When we chased after it, we found a hidden chamber, and Hebiko was there with several small octopuses.
「Hebiko! Thank goodness you're safe! Where are the other abducted Taimanin?」
「Uwaaaaaaaahhh～～～～～～!!! Wh-What do we do, Fuuma-chan?! Everyone got eaten up by octopuses～!!」
「It seems like they thought Hebiko was one of them, so she was spared, and locked up in this nursery, but......」
「It's all very well to mourn the death of your comrades, but first, we hurry up and dispose of those guys!」
Octo-Slayer-san said, pointing at the baby octopuses surrounding her.
「You're going to kill them......? But these boys are still children, and they don't seem like they would harm people......」
「Don't take them lightly. Many an adventurer's been done in by showing mercy like that.」
Without even answering Shikanosuke's question, he mercilessly plunged his knife into the baby octopuses.
They lost strength, and soon melted away.
「It's a play on words. I'm an octopus slayer. When octopuses appear, call on me. I'll slaughter 'em.」
「But, why are you so obsessed with octopuses?」
「Well...... It was when I was still a child. My big sister, my one and only family......」
「Ate the octopus dumplings I had been saving for later.」
「Ever since, I've become compelled by nature to hunt down octopuses.」
「Seriously? Grudges over food are dangerous stuff, huh?」
Leaving us with that, Octo-Slayer-san departed.
Picking up all of the octopus legs that had been left lying around.
「Is he going to make octopus dumplings out of all of those? Hebiko's getting chills somehow.」
「At any rate, thanks to that person, we were able to subdue the octopuses.」
「But...... Shit, we weren't able to save everybody......!」
We had succeeded in subduing “them”――the octopuses, but the only one we had been able to rescue was Hebiko.
Despondent, we had returned to Gosha Academy.
「Hey, Fuuma! Gosha Village got surprise attacked and overrun, right?」
「That's supposed to be the case, but......」
There lay Gosha Academy, as we were always used to seeing it.
There was no sign of devastation anywhere, and the Taimanin who were meant to have been abducted were leaving school with smiling faces.
We were standing there motionlessly, flabbergasted by the puzzling situation.
「Well done. Both of you passed. Thank you for your assistance, Hebiko-chan.」
Hebiko answered with a smiling face, and stood next to Asagi-sensei.
「Eh? Eh? What's going on, Hebiko? Assistance?」
「You two are slow, aren't you? This was a pop test!」
「Then, that stuff about Gosha getting attacked was——」
「And the part about Hebiko and the others being kidnapped was also......」
「A lie, of course! Sorry for scaring you☆」
Hebiko apologized, but her face looked delighted, like she was saying 『The prank was a big success☆』
「～～～Man, don't startle me like that! But, what the hell were those octopuses?」
「Those were some things Kiryuu-san made, using Hebiko's Taima particles without asking! And then they split apart, and multiplied more and more......」
「When Hebiko consulted Asagi-sensei about them, she decided, “Let's have a pop test while we're at it.”」
「Those octopuses were just overly friendly, and didn't really do any harm, but it would have been a problem if they multiplied infinitely, after all......」
「Well, that's certainly true...... But even so, wasn't the lie too massive?! Just ordering us to suppress the octopuses would have been enough, wouldn't it?」
「That's because it's April 1st. You have to add a little humour, right?」
「Ah, then the Octo-Slayer-san was a friend of Asagi-sensei's too? No wonder he was strong～!」
「Yeah, yeah! Hebiko wasn't told she would have a helper like that!」
Asagi-sensei tilted her head in confusion, and Shikanosuke and I exchanged looks.
（The whole incident was a lie, but Octo-Slayer-san was real...... I guess?）
The curtain closed on this spring storm of an incident, leaving a touch of mystery behind――
